verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents per-framework control mapping with automated control testing (docs-60). For CMMC specifically, it maps controls to requirements to "identify gaps and readiness status" and offers an SPRS score tracker (docs-73, docs-72). It also continuously monitors compliance status and surfaces failing tests (docs-12, docs-9), so the core readiness and gap tracking is there. The evidence never describes a readiness dashboard that shows a per-framework completion percentage across all frameworks. missing for 10: an explicit per-framework readiness percentage view, a breakdown of passing controls vs. open gaps vs. remaining work for every framework (not just CMMC), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
